components.name: libgit2 (in libgit2-sys)
components.notice: Compiled into libfreedom_mobile_ffi.so from source by the libgit2-sys crate, for Radicle's git storage. The linking exception lets it be linked into a program under other terms. It includes SHA-1 collision detection (MIT), wildmatch (BSD), the RFC 6234 SHA-256 code (BSD-style) and xoroshiro256** (public domain), and bundles LibXDiff, PCRE2 and llhttp, listed on their own. libgit2's COPYING file below gives every one of these licences.

components.name: LibXDiff (in libgit2)
components.notice: Copyright (C) 2003 Davide Libenzi, with changes by the Git and libgit2 authors. libgit2 1.9.6 bundles it (deps/xdiff) and libgit2-sys compiles it into libfreedom_mobile_ffi.so; its source is at the address above.

components.name: PCRE2 (in libgit2)
components.notice: libgit2's regular-expression backend, bundled with it (deps/pcre2) and compiled into libfreedom_mobile_ffi.so by libgit2-sys.

components.name: llhttp (in libgit2)
components.notice: libgit2's HTTP parser, bundled with it (deps/llhttp) and compiled into libfreedom_mobile_ffi.so by libgit2-sys.

components.name: liblzma, XZ Utils (in liblzma-sys)
components.notice: Copyright (C) The XZ Utils authors and contributors. Compiled into libfreedom_mobile_ffi.so from source by the liblzma-sys crate (Tor's directory downloads).

components.name: SQLite (in libsqlite3-sys)
components.notice: The amalgamation bundled with the libsqlite3-sys crate, compiled into libfreedom_mobile_ffi.so. Radicle's sqlite bindings use the same copy.

components.name: libffi (in JNA's libjnidispatch.so)
components.notice: JNA 5.17.0 links its copy of libffi statically into libjnidispatch.so.

components.name: OpenLV (@openlv/core, @openlv/session, @openlv/signaling, @openlv/transport)
components.notice: Copyright (c) Open-Lavatory contributors. Shipped unmodified in the separate, replaceable file assets/openlv/openlv.esm.js inside the APK (built by desktop Freedom's scripts/bundle-openlv.js from the published npm packages), so it can be exchanged for a modified version as the LGPL allows. The LGPL-3.0 adds its terms to those of the GNU GPL 3.0, whose text follows it.

components.name: EasyList, EasyPrivacy, Fanboy's Cookiemonster and Fanboy's Annoyance List
components.notice: The filter lists are © The EasyList authors (https://easylist.to/), dual-licensed under the GNU General Public License v3 or later and the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported licence (or later). Freedom redistributes them, unmodified, under CC BY-SA 3.0. The copies built into the app are assets/adblock/*.txt.

nativeCode.blst 0.3.17: blst's own C and assembly, under the crate's Apache-2.0.
nativeCode.libgit2-sys 0.18.7+1.9.6: Compiles libgit2 1.9.6 with its bundled LibXDiff, PCRE2 and llhttp (all listed). Built without the ssh and https features: no libssh2, no OpenSSL. zlib comes from libz-sys.
nativeCode.liblzma-sys 0.4.9: Compiles liblzma from XZ Utils 5.8.4 (listed); pkg-config finds no liblzma for an Android target.
nativeCode.libsqlite3-sys 0.37.0: The bundled feature (from rusqlite's): compiles the SQLite 3.51.3 amalgamation (listed). sqlite3-sys links against the same copy; freedom-mobile-ffi's vendor/sqlite3-src stand-in compiles nothing.
nativeCode.libz-sys 1.1.29: On Android it links the system libz.so and compiles nothing.
nativeCode.reed-solomon-erasure 6.0.0: cc is only for the simd-accel feature, which isn't enabled: pure Rust.
nativeCode.ring 0.17.14: ring's own C and assembly (partly from BoringSSL), covered by the licence files listed for the crate.
nativeCode.zstd-sys 2.1.0+zstd.1.5.7: Compiles zstd 1.5.7, whose BSD licence is among the texts listed for the crate.

nativeLibraries.libfreedom_mobile_ffi.so: The Rust crates in native.json, and the C code listed with inCrate
nativeLibraries.libc4.so: Colibri and what it links (the components with colibri)
